headline: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Could Be 10% Overvalued Following Leadership Change
summary: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) is back in focus after longtime executive Jennifer Taubert retired as Executive Vice President, Worldwide Chairman, Innovative Medicine, with experienced biopharmaceutical leader Tom Cavanaugh set to succeed her. See our latest analysis for Johnson & Johnson. Johnson & Johnson’s share price has had a strong run in 2026, with a year to date share price return of 22.95% and a 90 day share price return of 13.49%, while the 1 year total shareholder return of 53.04%...
